# The Rock Fan Club

> An unofficial fan site about Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson: movies, a fan-written biography, videos, photos and a fan club with membership cards. Not run by, affiliated with or endorsed by Dwayne Johnson or his team.

## Pages
- [Home](__SITE_URL__/): age-morph portrait, fan club sign-up, movies, videos and photos.
- [About](__SITE_URL__/about.html): fan-written biography, from his wrestling family and Miami football to WWE and Hollywood.
- [Movies](__SITE_URL__/movies.html): every film from 2001 to 2026 with roles and trailers, plus a fan-picked top 10.
- [Videos](__SITE_URL__/videos.html) and [Photos](__SITE_URL__/photos.html): clips and photos collected by fans.
- [Fan Club](__SITE_URL__/fanclub.html): join the (unofficial) fan club and make a membership card.
- [Contact](__SITE_URL__/contact.html): write to the fan club. Letters are not forwarded to Dwayne Johnson.
- [Full reference](__SITE_URL__/llms-full.txt)
